name: get_something_on_it
why: They taught a loop: memory_store pref/calendar AND run it this turn — ask what goes on today. Never just agree.
inbound: If nothing is on my schedule, get something on it.

tools.name: google__calendar_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events for a day. Args: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today).

tools.name: google__calendar_create_events
tools.description: Create one or many events in one call. Required: events[{summary, start_time, end_time}]. A single event is a one-element list.

events.description: One element for a single event.
